literal: Unbroken lineage-came friends' friendship those who do not forsake desires the world.
translation: The world will cherish those who never forsake their bond with friends of an unbroken, long-standing lineage.
modern: தலைமுறை தலைமுறையாகத் தொடர்ந்து வரும் பழைய நண்பர்களின் நட்பைக் கைவிடாமல் காப்பவர்களை இந்த உலகம் விரும்பிப் போற்றும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the value of maintaining long-standing, ancestral friendships. The phrase 'keṭāa vaḻivanta' refers to a relationship that has come down through generations without breaking. 'Kēṇmaiyār' denotes friends who share such an enduring bond. The world greatly admires and desires the company of those who refuse to let go of such deep-rooted ties. By preserving old friendships, a person earns the respect and affection of society.
